nodes.body: Adding a new `DotfileCandidate` under the AI-tools section of `src/dotfile_candidates.rs` is not the whole change: it must also get a matching bullet in `CHANGELOG.md`'s `[Unreleased]` section, in this project's `- **Component**: description` format (Keep a Changelog style). This step was missed for the two most recent OpenCode entries and had to be backfilled after release. Treat the CHANGELOG bullet as a mandatory last step whenever a new dotfile candidate is added, even when nobody restates it.
nodes.title: Close out a new dotfile candidate with a CHANGELOG entry
